info.title: RollerAds API
info.description:
A set of endpoints for advertisers, publishers, and affiliates to manage ad campaigns, placements, offers and reporting.

URL: https://api.rollerads.com/v2

Note: It is necessary to pass `ACCESS_TOKEN` in each request. To get `ACCESS_TOKEN`, please contact your account manager. `ACCESS_TOKEN` can be passed either as a GET parameter (`?access_token={ACCESS_TOKEN}`) or as a header (`X-ACCESS-TOKEN = {ACCESS_TOKEN}`). The token's life is not limited until it is deleted or changed.

Note: In case of a successful response, the server will return the response object containing the response to the request; in case of an error, the error object will be returned, which contains the code with the error message. Errors can be as general, i.e. have the same code in different methods, and unique to specific methods.

Rate limits (beta): Each access token can make up to 300 requests per clock minute across all endpoints. Some endpoints also have their own limit per clock minute: statistics (`/statistics/*`, `/sites/stat`) — 10 requests, campaign creation (`POST /campaigns`) — 10 requests. On these endpoints the headers below show this limit. Report status polling (`/common/report`) is not counted. Every response includes the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the minute ends) headers. The limits are in observation mode for now: requests over the limit are not rejected. Once they are enforced, such requests will get `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header.

accessToken.description: Enter your Access Token. To get one, please contact your account manager.
accessToken.name: X-ACCESS-TOKEN

message.description:
Core message settings (JSON object in multipart field `message`). For `message_type` `rss`, `payloads` must be omitted and `send_type` is forced to `now`.

| Property              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              | Default value | Required |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | -------- |
| **message_type**      | Message delivery mode: instant, scheduled, rss, welcome.                                                                                                                                                 |               | Yes      |
| **message_title**     | Message name shown in the panel (3–120 characters).                                                                                                                                                      |               | Yes      |
| **message_status**    | Initial status: active, paused, draft.                                                                                                                                                                   |               | No       |
| **message_ttl**       | Time-to-live in seconds for subscribers who were offline (positive integer, max 604800 = 7 days).                                                                                                        |               | No       |
| **rss_url**           | RSS feed URL (HTTP/HTTPS, up to 1024 characters). Only when `message_type` is `rss`.                                                                                                                 |               | No       |
| **send_type**         | When to send: `now`, specific_time (`send_scheduled_at`), or schedule (`send_schedule`). For rss — always `now`. Cannot set both `send_schedule` and `send_scheduled_at `                    |               | No       |
| **send_scheduled_at** | Single send datetime string when `send_type` is `specific_time`.                                                                                                                                     |               | No       |
| **send_schedule**     | Recurring schedule object when `send_type` is `schedule`: `type` (`every_day`, `days_week`, `days_month`), required `hours` (0–23), optional `days_week` (0–6) or `days_month` (1–31). |               | No       |

payloads.description:
Push payloads / creatives for the message (array in multipart field `payloads`, each item is form fields with prefix or a JSON array depending on client). **Omitted when `message_type` is `rss`** — RSS messages do not use manual payloads.

| Property               | Description                                                                                                    | Default value | Required |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| ------------- | -------- |
| **payload_title**      | Notification title (1–64 characters).                                                                          |               | Yes      |
| **payload_descr**      | Notification body text (1–240 characters).                                                                     |               | Yes      |
| **payload_url_target** | Landing URL (HTTP/HTTPS; if the scheme is omitted, `https://` is prefixed).                                  |               | Yes      |
| **image_192**          | Icon image file (JPEG, PNG, WEBP) or URL, 192×192 logical size. Max size per project limits (typically 8MB).   |               | No*      |
| **image_360**          | Large image file or URL, 360×240 logical size. Same formats as `image_192`.                                  |               | No*      |
| **payload_delay**      | Delay before this payload is sent (seconds), for chain-type flows.                                             |               | No       |
| **send_scheduled_at**  | Per-payload scheduled send time when used by product flows.                                                    |               | No       |

targetings.description: Audience targeting for the message (JSON object in multipart field `targetings`). Optional top-level keys: `geo`, `device`, `browser`, `lang`, `zone`, `ageGroup`, `audience`.

campaign.description:
The list of supported fields may vary depending on the selected ad format and bid model.

| Property                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                    | Default value | Required |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------- | -------- |
| **format_id**                         | Specifies the format for the campaign (1: Push notifications, 2: OnClick, 3: In-page push, 4: Native, 7: Direct Click).                                                        |               | Yes      |
| **bid_model_id**                      | Specifies the bidding model for the campaign (1: CPC, 2: CPM, 5: SmartCPC, 6: SmartCPM, 7: CPA Goal CPC, 8: CPA Goal CPM, 9: CPC (Direct Click), 10: SmartCPC (Direct Click)). |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_type**                     | Defines whether the creatives are automatically or manually generated (auto_creative: auto-generated creatives, normal: manually created creatives).                           | normal        | No       |
| **campaign_title**                    | The title of the campaign (3-128 characters).                                                                                                                                  |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_url_target**               | The URL that the campaign will direct users to. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL (5-2048 characters).                                                                         |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_bid**                      | The bid amount for the campaign.                                                                                                                                               |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_freq_impression_cnt**      | The maximum number of impressions allowed per user within a given period. Valid values are 0-99 (0 disables the limit).                                                        | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_impression_hour**     | The time period (in hours) over which the frequency cap is applied. Valid values are 0-200 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_click_cnt**           | The maximum number of clicks allowed per user within a given period. Valid values are 0-99 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_click_hour**          | The time period (in hours) over which the frequency cap is applied. Valid values are 0-200 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_spent_day**                | The maximum daily budget for the campaign (0 disables the limit).                                                                                                              | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_spent_total**              | The maximum total budget for the campaign (0 disables the limit).                                                                                                              | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_smart_mode**               | The smart bidding mode for the campaign (default: No per-zone click limits, uniform: Normalized buying, zone_country_limit: Limit every zone to exact total number of clicks). | default       | No       |
| **campaign_smart_zone_country_limit** | When using smart bidding, this limits every zone to exact total number of clicks/impressions (10-10,000). Only relevant if campaign_smart_mode is set as zone_country_limit.   | 50            | No       |
| **campaign_smart_coefficient**        | A coefficient used to adjust the smart bidding algorithm (0-9).                                                                                                                | 1             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_optimizer**            | Switches the CPA optimization mode (0: Disabled, 1: Recommended, 2: Custom).                                                                                                   | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_target**               | The target CPA for the campaign (0.01-999). Only relevant if campaign_cpa_optimizer is enabled.                                                                                | 1             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_zone_limit**           | The amount of money (0.02-1999) you want to spend on testing one zone before it makes a conversion. Only relevant if bid_model_id is set as 7 or 8.                            |               | No       |
| **campaign_status**                   | The initial status of the campaign (active, draft or paused).                                                                                                                  | active        | No       |
| **campaign_smooth_limit**             | Spreads the daily limit evenly across 24 hours or according to the set schedule. Requires campaign_spent_day to be set                                                         | 0             | No       |

creatives.description:
The visual and textual elements of an ad. This field is required only for ad campaigns using "format_id" 1 (Push notifications), 3 (In-page push), and 4 (Native). When campaign_type is set as auto_creative, then creative should consist only of cat_adv_id field

| Property           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------ | -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **creative_title** | A title for the push, in-page, or native notification (3-64 characters).                                                                                                                                               |
| **creative_descr** | A description of the push or in-page notification (up to 128 characters). For native format, max 90 characters.                                                                                                        |
| **image_360**      | A 360x240 pixel image file (JPEG, PNG, or WEBP format) OR the URL of an existing image. For native format: 1200x675 (16:9). This is required if you're not using a auto creatives (catadv_id). Maximum file size: 8MB. |
| **image_192**      | A 192x192 pixel image file (JPEG, PNG, or WEBP format) OR the URL of an existing image. This is required if you're not using a auto creatives (catadv_id). Optional for native. Maximum file size: 8MB.                |
| **catadv_id**      | The ID of ad category that enables the auto creatives. If you provide this, you don't need to upload image_192 or image_360. Valid values are 14 or 16 (software and utilities ad vertical).                           |

optimizer_rules.description:
The configuration for custom optimization rules, which can be used to tailor the campaign's behavior based on performance metrics. This field is required if "campaign_cpa_optimizer" is set to 2 (Custom). All fields are required.

| Property         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **within**       | The time period within which the optimizer rule should be applied, specified in seconds. Valid values include: 10800 (3 hours), 21600 (6 hours), 43200 (12 hours), 86400 (24 hours), 172800 (2 days), 259200 (3 days), 604800 (7 days).      |
| **action**       | The action to be taken when the rule conditions are met. Possible values are: "pause", "bid_increase", "bid_decrease".                                                                                                                       |
| **operand**      | Defines the operand for the optimizer rule, including how conditions are combined and evaluated. It contains the following fields:                                                                                                           |
| - **type**       | The type of operand, indicating whether it represents a condition or a value. Valid values are: "CONDITION", "VALUE".                                                                                                                        |
| - **operator**   | The logical operator used to combine multiple conditions or values. Valid values are: "AND", "OR".                                                                                                                                           |
| - **operands**   | A list of nested operand items that represent the specific conditions or values to be evaluated. Each operand item consists of the following fields:                                                                                         |
| --- **type**     | The type of the operand item, indicating whether it is a condition or a value. Valid values are: "CONDITION", "VALUE".                                                                                                                       |
| --- **operator** | The comparison operator used in the condition. Valid operators include: "LE" (less than or equal), "LT" (less than), "EQ" (equal to), "GT" (greater than), "GE" (greater than or equal to).                                                  |
| --- **metric**   | The performance metric used to evaluate the condition. Valid metrics include: "conversions", "cost", "spent", "ctr" (Click-Through Rate), "cr" (Conversion Rate), "impressions", "cpa" (Cost Per Acquisition), "cpa_with_target", "clicks".  |
| --- **value**    | The numeric value that the metric is compared against using the specified operator. This defines the threshold or target for the condition.                                                                                                  |

targetings.description:
Targetings define the criteria for delivering ads to specific audiences. The "geo" targeting is required.

| Property       | Description                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **proxy**      | Specifies how the campaign should handle traffic from proxy users (allow, only, deny).               |

| --- **type**     | The type of the operand item, indicating whether it is a condition or a value. Valid values are: "CONDITION", "VALUE".                                                                                                                       |
| --- **operator** | The comparison operator used in the condition. Valid operators include: "LE" (less than or equal), "LT" (less than), "EQ" (equal to), "GT" (greater than), "GE" (greater than or equal to).                                                  |
| --- **metric**   | The performance metric used to evaluate the condition. Valid metrics include: "conversions", "cost", "spent", "ctr" (Click-Through Rate), "cr" (Conversion Rate), "impressions", "cpa" (Cost Per Acquisition), "cpa_with_target", "clicks".  |
| --- **value**    | The numeric value that the metric is compared against using the specified operator. This defines the threshold or target for the condition.                                                                                                  |

targetings.description:
Targetings define the criteria for delivering ads to specific audiences. The "geo" targeting is required.

| Property       | Description                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **proxy**      | Specifies how the campaign should handle traffic from proxy users (allow, only, deny).               |

campaign.description:
The list of supported fields may vary depending on the selected ad format and bid model.

| Property                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                    | Default value | Required |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------- | -------- |
| **campaign_type**                     | Defines whether the creatives are automatically or manually generated (auto_creative: auto-generated creatives, normal: manually created creatives).                           | normal        | No       |
| **campaign_title**                    | The title of the campaign (3-128 characters).                                                                                                                                  |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_url_target**               | The URL that the campaign will direct users to. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL (5-2048 characters).                                                                         |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_bid**                      | The bid amount for the campaign.                                                                                                                                               |               | Yes      |
| **campaign_freq_impression_cnt**      | The maximum number of impressions allowed per user within a given period. Valid values are 0-99 (0 disables the limit).                                                        | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_impression_hour**     | The time period (in hours) over which the frequency cap is applied. Valid values are 0-200 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_click_cnt**           | The maximum number of clicks allowed per user within a given period. Valid values are 0-99 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_freq_click_hour**          | The time period (in hours) over which the frequency cap is applied. Valid values are 0-200 (0 disables the limit).                                                             | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_spent_day**                | The maximum daily budget for the campaign (0 disables the limit).                                                                                                              | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_spent_total**              | The maximum total budget for the campaign (0 disables the limit).                                                                                                              | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_smart_mode**               | The smart bidding mode for the campaign (default: No per-zone click limits, uniform: Normalized buying, zone_country_limit: Limit every zone to exact total number of clicks). | default       | No       |
| **campaign_smart_zone_country_limit** | When using smart bidding, this limits every zone to exact total number of clicks/impressions (10-10,000). Only relevant if campaign_smart_mode is set as zone_country_limit.   | 50            | No       |
| **campaign_smart_coefficient**        | A coefficient used to adjust the smart bidding algorithm (0-9).                                                                                                                | 1             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_optimizer**            | Switches the CPA optimization mode (0: Disabled, 1: Recommended, 2: Custom).                                                                                                   | 0             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_target**               | The target CPA for the campaign (0.01-999). Only relevant if campaign_cpa_optimizer is enabled.                                                                                | 1             | No       |
| **campaign_cpa_zone_limit**           | The amount of money (0.02-1999) you want to spend on testing one zone before it makes a conversion. Only relevant if bid_model_id is set as 7 or 8.                            |               | No       |
| **campaign_status**                   | The initial status of the campaign (active, draft, archived or paused).                                                                                                        | active        | No       |
